description: This file defines an abstract class 'BaseQueue' for managing job queues using the 'bullmq' library. It includes methods for adding jobs, creating workers, retrieving jobs, and handling queue events, with environment-based configuration.

classes.name: BaseQueue
classes.description: An abstract class providing queue management functionalities, including job processing, worker creation, and queue operations.

methods.name: processJob
methods.description: Abstract method to process a job with given data.

methods.name: getQueueName
methods.description: Abstract method to get the queue's name.

methods.name: getQueue
methods.description: Abstract method to get the queue instance.

methods.name: addJob
methods.description: Adds a new job to the queue with optional removal conditions based on environment variables.

methods.name: createWorker
methods.description: Creates and configures a worker to process jobs, with logging and error handling.

methods.name: getJobs
methods.description: Retrieves all jobs from the queue.

methods.name: getJobCounts
methods.description: Retrieves counts of jobs in different states.

methods.name: getJobByName
methods.description: Finds and returns a job by its name.

methods.name: clearQueue
methods.description: Obliterates all jobs in the queue.
